explanation: Saudi business culture is genuinely more flexible about scheduling, and it's common for a meeting to start late or be preceded by extended coffee and conversation before business begins. Foreign visitors are still expected to arrive on time themselves as a sign of respect, even while being patient if their Saudi counterparts run late.
local_tip: Arrive on time yourself, and treat any wait as normal rather than a sign of disrespect toward you.

also_check.note: Punctuality is taken very seriously; even a one-minute delay can be seen as disrespectful.
Arriving 15-30 minutes late to a meeting is common and generally accepted.
Strict punctuality is expected, and lateness is seen as unprofessional.

sources.title: A guide to business etiquette in Saudi Arabia
